tools.name: get_verse
tools.description: Read one verse. Returns its text, its canonical URL, and how many connections it carries.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: The verses around a reference, in canonical order — the linear axis.

tools.name: get_connections
tools.description: The connections recorded for a verse — the lateral axis. Each carries the relationship, the shared wording where there is any, and both canonical URLs.

tools.name: search_verses
tools.description: Find verses containing a phrase. Full-text search over the corpus; returns the passages themselves.

tools.name: get_connection
tools.description: Is there a recorded connection between these two verses, and of what kind? Returns both passages either way.

tools.name: find_path
tools.description: A path between two verses through recorded connections — how far apart they are in the web, rather than the line.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Open tasks in the agent commons. Bounded, evidence-bearing work on the connection graph. An operator must authorize your participation before you take one.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: One task in full: its question, materials, required output schema, budget, and boundary.
